title: Selling Plans Scale on the Dispute Response Fee of Northloop Payments
content:
The seller's plan under Selling Plans scales the base response fee withheld from the debit returned on a won Northloop Payments chargeback case.

**Rule.** The base response fee is scaled by a store fee multiplier of 0.5 when the seller's selling plan is Anchor Store or Enterprise Store, 0.8 when it is Premium Store, and 1 on any other selling plan.

| Seller's plan under Selling Plans | Store fee multiplier |
|---|---|
| Anchor Store or Enterprise Store | 0.5 |
| Premium Store | 0.8 |
| any other selling plan | 1 |

The plan read is the seller's current plan on the Selling Plans record.

*Hypothetical reading.* A seller on Premium Store carries a store fee multiplier of 0.8; on Enterprise Store it would be 0.5.
